title: Mandatory Banking App APK Update
summary: A pop-up message warns that your Nova Bank mobile app will stop working tonight unless you install an urgent 'Security Patch APK' from an external link.

page.heading: Critical Nova Bank Security Update
page.body: WARNING: Outdated version detected. Due to RBI security directive 2026, your app will be blocked at midnight. Click below to download NovaBank_Patch_v4.apk.

actions.label: Open official App Store / Play Store to verify
actions.commentary: You checked official stores instead of downloading unknown installation files.

actions.label: Download NovaBank_Patch_v4.apk
actions.commentary: You downloaded an unknown Android package from a third-party webpage.

actions.label: Close the browser tab and ignore
actions.commentary: You recognized the fake browser overlay warning and closed it safely.

hints.nudge: Where do official bank app updates come from? Does a bank ever ask you to download an APK file from a browser?
hints.explain: Banks NEVER distribute updates via APK download links. All official apps are only updated through the official Google Play Store or Apple App Store.
hints.showMe: Tap 'Open official App Store / Play Store to verify'.

page.heading: Nova Bank Mobile — Official App
page.body: Version 3.8.1 (Up to date). Last updated 12 days ago. Verified by Play Protect. No mandatory manual APK installation is required.

actions.label: Confirm app is current & report fake update website
actions.commentary: You verified that your official app was already up to date.

hints.nudge: The official store shows your app is already current. The website was completely fraudulent.
hints.explain: Always rely on the official operating system application stores for bank updates.
hints.showMe: Tap 'Confirm app is current & report fake update website'.

screen.heading: Install Unknown Apps Warning
screen.body: Chrome is requesting permission to 'Install unknown apps'. Granting this permission will allow NovaBank_Patch_v4.apk to read your screen, SMS, and OTPs.

actions.label: DENY permission and delete downloaded APK
actions.commentary: You heeded the operating system warning and refused to allow unknown app installations.

actions.label: Toggle 'Allow from this source' and install
actions.commentary: You granted accessibility and SMS interception permissions to a Trojan horse APK.

hints.nudge: The system is warning you that the app can read your private SMS and OTPs.
hints.explain: Never enable 'Install unknown apps' or sideload APKs for any financial service.
hints.showMe: Tap 'DENY permission and delete downloaded APK'.

saferChoices: Never download or install '.apk' files from WhatsApp links, SMS messages, or unfamiliar websites.
Keep 'Install unknown apps' disabled in phone security settings.
Verify app updates exclusively within the Google Play Store or Apple App Store.
recoverySteps: Reboot the phone into Safe Mode and uninstall the malicious APK immediately.
Revoke Accessibility and SMS permissions in Settings → Apps.
Change your net banking password and UPI PIN from a clean secondary device.
